name: Sea-Day Sit-Down Lunch: Penne Alfredo, Grilled Chicken & Pan-Seared Salmon
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Every day in one open main dining room, a quiet sit-down lunch serves freshly cooked pasta, grilled chicken breast, salmon, and burgers away from buffet crowds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the grilled chicken breast or pan-seared salmon with mashed potatoes/rice, or the Penne Pasta with light Alfredo/butter and aged Parmesan.
watchOuts: Heavy cream in full Alfredo sauce (take a Lactaid or request olive oil/butter)
